verdict.line: You lose if you trade into a fully-charged Haymaker without your shield up; you win if you out-scale his all-in past level 6 with Rylai's kite and duel him solo with Realm of Death.

brief.thesis: This matchup is a real 50.9% coinflip over 639 games because both champions win the fight differently: Sett wants to burst you down inside 3-5 seconds with his Q-W-E chain before you can react, while Mordekaiser wants to survive that window with Indestructible and then grind him out with sustained magic damage and a forced 1v1 in Realm of Death. Whoever dictates when the fight actually starts wins it.

theirWindow.when: he holds W fully charged and closes in
theirWindow.what: A maxed Haymaker heals him off your missing HP and hits harder than any single trade he has. Do not stand still in melee range while his fists are pulled back — back off or pre-emptively pop Indestructible so the shield eats the punch instead of your HP bar.

yourWindow.what: Without Facebreaker he has no gap-closer or wall-stun combo, so he can only threaten you with autos and Q. Walk up, land E (Death's Grasp) to root/slow him, then Q (Obliterate) — you get a free trade he can't fully answer.

start.item: Doran's Ring, Health Potion, Health Potion
start.why: 51.8% win rate over 606 games and the 73.5% pick rate reflect that Morde needs the extra sustain and AP scaling to survive early trades into Sett's autos rather than the flat armor of Doran's Shield.

boots.why: 86.8% pick rate and directly matches the live tip: armor before closing in mitigates his auto-reset damage and the physical half of his Q and R.

core.why: the slow on Q and E lets you kite Sett's melee range and land Death's Grasp reliably instead of trading auto for auto
true damage ramp and the omnivamp let you win extended fights and duels inside Realm of Death
the highest-sample core path (62 games, 56.5% win rate) — burn damage punishes him for standing in melee range to land Q stacks

situational.when: sett is snowballing or you need to shut down his Haymaker healing directly
you're losing the early trades and need cheap armor plus anti-heal before his first back
his team stacks magic damage or CC and you need more ability haste and healing power in extended fights

runes.keystoneWhy: the stacking adaptive damage and healing reward exactly the extended melee trades and duels this matchup comes down to, and it's the 55.5%-pick page in the live data

summoners.why: 77.8% pick rate and the top win rate (51.2%) — Ignite denies his Haymaker heal-back on kill attempts, which is the exact mechanic that swings this matchup either direction.

playing.title: Hold Indestructible for his W
playing.detail: Don't shield preemptively on cooldown — bait the fully charged Haymaker, then pop W right as it lands so the shield (and his lost heal) eats it instead of your HP.

playing.title: Punish empty E cooldowns
playing.detail: Facebreaker is his only gap-closer. The moment it's down, walk up and force a Q-E trade he can't escape.

playing.title: Freeze to deny his Q stacking
playing.detail: Sett's Knuckle Down wants free auto resets on minions and you. Hold the wave near your tower so he has to overextend to get value.

playing.title: Save Realm of Death for isolation, not just burst
playing.detail: Ulting him removes his ability to disengage toward allies or walls for a Facebreaker combo — use it to trap him in a straight duel, not only to secure a kill.

playing.title: Track his grit shield before all-inning
playing.detail: His passive shield pops when his resolve bar fills from taking or dealing damage. If it's up, delay your all-in a beat rather than dumping cooldowns into a free shield.

playing.title: Pivot to Thornmail if he's healing off you
playing.detail: If Haymaker sustain is keeping him in lane or fights, swap a core slot for Thornmail — it directly answers the mechanic that wins him trades.

brief.patchCaveat: All win rates, item paths, rune pages, and summoner splits above are measured OP.GG numbers from live games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own read on why those numbers land where they do.

stats.opponentTip: Purchase Plated Steelcaps and other items with armor before closing in to fight Sett. Try to use [W] when he uses (W).
